name: @anywalletkit/protocol-swap2-uniswap
description: Uniswap v3 + v4 same-chain swaps from the contracts only (QuoterV2 + SwapRouter02; v4, opt-in, on pinned hookless pools through Universal Router 2.1.2 — native input directly, token input through Uniswap's SwapProxy): no API key, no frontend, addresses verified on-chain.
